value.rationale: Recovery availability measures tolerance to disjoint missing-coordinate patterns and is not determined by the already-known [length,dimension,distance] parameters. The proof yields a precise parity-sensitive all-parameter classification of whether symbols have multiple independent repair routes, and the first genuine three-set instance, with a sharp finite upper bound. It refrains from claiming larger even-rank exact availabilities or publication-scale novelty.
